SELECT 
    SUM(patient_count) as total_above_average_count,
    ROUND(AVG(share_pct), 2) as avg_share,
    ROUND(AVG(patient_count - avg_per_sex), 2) as avg_excess
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(p.SEX, '[NULL]') as sex_group,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) as patient_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Examination) as share_pct,
        (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) as cnt
            FROM Examination e
            LEFT JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
            GROUP BY COALESCE(p.SEX, '[NULL]')
        )) as avg_per_sex
    FROM Examination e
    LEFT JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY sex_group
    HAVING patient_count > (
        SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) as cnt
            FROM Examination e
            LEFT JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
            GROUP BY COALESCE(p.SEX, '[NULL]')
        )
    )
)
